text:
Elena (PM): quick sync — need to lock Q2 observability scope for Console. primary asks: dashboards UX polish, tracing sampling defaults, error-analysisinvestigation UX, and retention tiers. who's on for a rapid decision today?
Raj (Eng): I can do a 15m to run through technical constraints. main tradeoff = retention vs cost on hosted customers.
Sasha (DevEx): +1. we have 3 customer threads asking for longer trace retention (Acme Health, Nimbus) and better trace-to-error linking.
Ben (SRE): FYI infra can support a soft 30d default for logs/metrics but traces at 7d without extra budget. longer traces ~ 2.5x storage and cpu for queries.
Elena (PM): options proposal: A) Prioritize dashboards + error-analysis (fast UX wins) and keep current trace retention (7d), B) Prioritize trace retention extension to 30d for tiered paying customers + sampling changes, C) MVP of all three with strict rollout + cost guardrails. need recommended option + owners.
Kai (Data): If we extend trace retention, we should change sampling to head-based adaptive sampling. that brings down storage 30% in our sims. also we can add a sampling knob per-tenant.
Raj (Eng): technical notes: implementing per-tenant sampling is ~3w of eng work (runtime + api + migration). trace storage tiering (cold storage) could be another 2w. dashboards polish is mostly frontend + queries (~1.5w). error-analysis (grouping + links to traces) is mid effort (~2w).
Sasha (DevEx): customer impact perspective: dashboards + error-analysis addresses 75% of support tickets. customers are loud about trace retention but many would accept better dashboarding if it reduces toil.
Elena (PM): proposal: pick B for enterprise tiers (30d traces + sampling) + A for self-serve (dashboards + error-analysis). rollout plan: canary to Dedicated customers first, then hosted. ask: can infra + eng commit to parallel workstreams?
Ben (SRE): we can take cold-tier blueprint and run it in parallel but need clear SLOs. requirement: cost-alerting per-customer and automatic fallback to 7d if a tenant exceeds cost percent.
Raj (Eng): agree. owners: Dashboards -> Sasha, Error-analysis -> Raj, Traces retention (tiered) -> Raj + Ben, Sampling work -> Kai + Raj. ETA: dashboards + error-analysis in 6 weeks, traces tiering + sampling 8-10 weeks.
Elena (PM): launch criteria draft (please thumbs if OK): 1) Dashboards: top-10 query perf < 500ms, UX flow validated by 3 customers, rollout doc. 2) Error-analysis: grouping precision > 85% on sampled dataset, trace link telemetry passes integration tests. 3) Trace retention tier: cost model validated, per-tenant cost alerts, automatic fallback implemented.
Kai (Data): can add a synthetic test to validate grouping precision and sampling effectiveness.
Sasha (DevEx): will assemble customer validation script and 3 pilot customers list.
Ben (SRE): need runbook entries and rollback steps for retention changes. I'll own runbook.
Elena (PM): ok — decision summary: hybrid approach (dashboards+error-analysis for all; 30d trace tier for enterprise). owners as assigned. next: set OKR mapping — someone volunteer to map these to Q2 OKRs?
Raj (Eng): I'll map to performance & reliability OKRs.
Sasha (DevEx): I'll map to onboarding & product-led expansion OKRs.
Elena (PM): perfect. follow-ups: 1) Sasha to share dashboard PRD by EOD Wed, 2) Raj to share tech plan for trace tier + sampling by Friday, 3) Ben to spec runbook and cost-alert config. please react with :thumbsup: when you accept.
ConsoleBot: Reminder — Weekly roadmap sync scheduled Thu 10:00.
Elena (PM): thanks all — posting these notes to the roadmap doc and OKR tracker. will close loop after tech plans.
